description.value: Washington Avenue Grill is a long-standing White Rock landmark with over 28 years of operation, serving upscale casual Pacific-Northwest cuisine from a dining room overlooking Semiahmoo Bay at the east end of White Rock Beach. The restaurant features an award-winning wine list, weekly live music, and has been recognized as one of Canada's top 100 scenic restaurants. Its location on Marine Drive places it directly on a popular waterfront cycling corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and detailed, confirming Washington Avenue Grill is an operational upscale casual restaurant on Marine Drive overlooking Semiahmoo Bay, consistently self-identified as 'White Rock, BC' — conflicting with the OSM community tag of 'Tsawwassen.' No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout options) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all are left null per evidence rules. Phone (604) 541-4244 is sourced from the website only since OSM carries no phone value.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'Tsawwassen' but website consistently identifies the address as 'White Rock, BC'; these are distinct municipalities and the contact page explicitly states 'far east end of White Rock Beach' — OSM community tag appears incorrect.
OSM carries no phone number; (604) 541-4244 taken from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone cannot be evaluated.
